item.title: British man infected with Ebola in DR Congo will be flown to UK
item.body: A British man infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is to be flown back to the UK. A government spokesperson said the wider risk to the UK public from the deadly virus remains low.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚠️ British man infected with Ebola in DR Congo will be flown to UK

A British man infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is to be flown back to the UK. A government spokesperson said the wider risk to the UK public from the deadly virus remains low.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 19:50
